name: Motion of the Moirai (General)
body:
The Fates themselves bless your movements, and curse the movements of your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Improbable class feature (fateful footing)

Benefit(s): The speed rate benefit from fateful footing is continuous as long as you have at least one moment of chance in your pool. You can reduce an affected targets speed rating by 30 ft (still a minimum of 5 feet) and if you are a 5th level luckbringer or higher the negative effects of fateful footing are permanent as bestow curse (caster level equal to your luckbringer class level).

Special: You can select this feat as an improbable ability so long as you meet its prerequisites.
